reason: The plugin is a lightweight user-facing utility that improves session management visibility by showing the active session ID in the chat session header and enabling one-click copy. Evidence points to a single-purpose UI/clipboard feature in the web client, with no declared external service integration, file modifications, or terminal/OS-level access, so risk is limited to potential local exposure of copied session IDs.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向会话界面的实用插件，在会话标题区域展示当前会话 ID，并支持一键将完整 ID 复制到剪贴板。
summaries.en: This is a session-interface utility plugin that shows the active session ID in the session header and enables one-click copying of the full ID to the clipboard.

capabilities: Adds a session header action in the web conversation UI
Reads and displays the current session identifier from the host session context
Copies the complete session ID to the clipboard via web clipboard APIs, with an execCommand fallback

reasons.code: README states the plugin displays the current session ID in the session header and copies it to the clipboard with one click.
README and implementation notes indicate use of web clipboard APIs (navigator.clipboard.writeText and document.execCommand('copy')).
package.json declares this as a DSH web client plugin (dsh.client.platform = web), showing client-side scope.
